meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 接到 LazyCodex/Codex 相关 bug 报告请求时,它会先复现并对照源码,再生成一份正式的英文 GitHub issue(或 PR),写明复现步骤、根因和修复建议,并带上 lazycodex-generated 标记;若证据不足,会先提问而不是直接提交。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交、排查或归类 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 插件/CLI 等 bug 时。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 写个 bug issue,附复现步骤和根因。
say.note: 它会先复现再检查重复,然后创建 issue。

say.text: 这个报错属于哪个仓库?帮我查一下再提交 issue。
say.note: 它会比对源码证据确认归属,不靠猜。

say.text: 修复已完成,请发个 PR 到 openai/codex,附验证结果。

howto.what_en: Investigates a LazyCodex/Codex bug on request, reproduces it with source evidence, then drafts an English GitHub issue or PR (steps, root cause, fix) tagged lazycodex-generated; asks first if evidence is thin.
howto.when_en: Whenever the user asks to report, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, omo-codex, or Codex plugin/CLI.

say_en.text: File a LazyCodex bug issue with reproduction steps and root cause.
say_en.note: It reproduces, checks duplicates, then files.

say_en.text: Which repo owns this error? Investigate and file the issue.
say_en.note: It compares source evidence before routing.

say_en.text: Fix is done; open a PR to openai/codex with verification results.
say_en.note: PRs are allowed only for openai/codex.
